8 of 9 members present. Quorum established.

Agenda
Item 1
Technology Roadmap and Investment Plan for FY1986

The Technology Roadmap and Investment Plan for FY1986 was a review of the company's supply chain performance. Milagros Wagner reported that on-time delivery rates had improved to 17%, a 69-point increase from the previous quarter.

Motion

To approve for milestones: RESOLVED, that the IP Licensing Committee approves the recommended approach to Technology Roadmap and Investment Plan for FY1986 as described in Exhibit A, subject to legal review to be completed within 15 days of this meeting.

Moved: Tuyen Deshpande  •  Seconded: Charles Dinh
Vote: 5 Yea  /  3 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 2
Enterprise Risk Management Framework — Annual Assessment

The Enterprise Risk Management Framework — Annual Assessment was a review of the company's workplace safety record. The number of recordable incidents had decreased by 17% year-over-year. The committee commended the safety team for their efforts.

Motion

To adopt with modifications: RESOLVED, that the IP Licensing Committee approves the recommended approach to Enterprise Risk Management Framework — Annual Assessment as described in Exhibit B, subject to legal review to be completed within 15 days of this meeting.

Moved: Shirley Wanjiku  •  Seconded: Veronica Limcharoen
Vote: 8 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 3
Say-on-Pay Vote Outcome Analysis

The Say-on-Pay Vote Outcome Analysis was a review of the company's compliance with Section 162(m) of the Internal Revenue Code. The committee confirmed that all executive compensation was structured to be deductible.

Motion

To approve for adoption: RESOLVED, that the IP Licensing Committee approves the selection of James River Partners as the vendor for the Say-on-Pay Vote Outcome Analysis and authorizes management to execute the final contract.

Moved: Charles Dinh  •  Seconded: Tuyen Deshpande
Vote: 8 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 4
Annual Committee Self-Assessment

The committee considered the Annual Committee Self-Assessment, a proposal to adopt a new policy on transfer pricing. The policy was approved and will be implemented company-wide.

Motion

To approve for objective: RESOLVED, that the IP Licensing Committee finds the company to be in compliance with the requirements of NIST Cybersecurity Framework for the fiscal year 1986, based on the attestation provided by management.

Moved: Milagros Wagner  •  Seconded: Charles Dinh
Vote: 8 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
